title: Mitigating Multimodal Hallucinations via Gradient-based Self-Reflection

bias_targets.methodology: Estimating and comparing the contribution of visual tokens versus text tokens to the model's output using first-order Taylor expansion gradients to compute token-level influence and visual influence ratios.

Measuring the hallucination rate of frequently paired objects (e.g., tables and chairs) using single-object images from the MSCOCO dataset, and analyzing whether hallucinated objects erroneously share the most influential visual token with the actually present object.
